---
title: "Author-approved combined biofilm screening definition and provenance"
format: html
editor: source
---

Author decision 2026-09-13: retain the union of the historical annotation-keyword
sets and current six-category annotation matches. This is a broad screening set,
not a curated database of experimentally validated biofilm genes. Historical
exact-symbol sensitivity remains separate: it was not part of the agreed3905.
No existing test p-values are transferred to this new definition.

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(data.table))
out<-commandArgs(TRUE)[1];stopifnot(!dir.exists(out))
root<-"/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569/derived"
src<-file.path(root,"biofilm_full_transcriptome_review_2026-09-13-v4/tables/gene_set_membership.tsv")
m<-fread(src)
a<-m[set_id=="biofilm_union",feature_id]
b<-m[set_id=="historical12",feature_id]
c<-m[set_id=="historical9",feature_id]
stopifnot(all(c %in% b),length(union(a,b))==3905)
x<-unique(m[feature_id %in% union(a,b),.(feature_id,MAG_ID,gene_symbol,annotation)])
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(x$feature_id),nrow(x)==3905)
x[,`:=`(set_id="biofilm_combined",in_historical9=feature_id %in% c,
 in_historical12=feature_id %in% b,in_current_categories=feature_id %in% a)]
rules<-m[!set_id %in% c("biofilm_union","historical_symbols"),
 .(matching_rules=paste(sort(unique(paste(set_id,match_rule,sep=":"))),collapse="; ")),by=feature_id]
x<-merge(x,rules,by="feature_id",all.x=TRUE)
dir.create(out,recursive=TRUE)
fwrite(x,file.path(out,"combined_gene_membership.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(x[,.(genes=.N),by=.(in_historical9,in_historical12,in_current_categories)],
 file.path(out,"overlap_counts.tsv"),sep="\t")
sha<-function(p)digest::digest(file=p,algo="sha256")
inputs<-c(src,Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_NOTEBOOK_PATH"))
fwrite(data.table(path=inputs,sha256=vapply(inputs,sha,character(1))),file.path(out,"input_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")
writeLines("Membership verified:3905 unique genes. Combined-set tests pending. No existing p-values inherited.",file.path(out,"CHECKS.txt"))
```
